annotations.title: Get the best time to ride

description: Use this when a visitor asks when to ride something to avoid long waits on a specific day within the next 30 days. Pass a ride ID or a unique short name such as Tron; pass park_id when the name could be in more than one park (Guardians). date accepts today, tomorrow, YYYY-MM-DD, or MM/DD/YYYY. A later date returns the furthest forecast day instead of an error; a past date is explained. Several matching rides are listed so you can ask again. Returns hourly predicted waits with bounds, the typical wait by hour for that weekday, and the best and worst windows in park-local time; these are estimates, not guarantees.

date.description: Park-local date: today, tomorrow, YYYY-MM-DD, or MM/DD/YYYY. Forecasts cover the next 30 park-local days (today through 29 days ahead). Defaults to today. A date after that window returns the furthest forecast day; a past date is explained instead of failing.

park_id.description: Park key (magic-kingdom), canonical park ID, park name, or shorthand such as mk, epcot, hs, ak, dl, dca, usf, ioa, epic or ush. A park name works directly, with no lookup first. Optional here: it narrows a partial ride name.

ride_id.description: Ride ID from parky_find_experience or parky_list_park_rides (for example magic-kingdom_seven-dwarfs-mine-train), or a ride name or slug when it is unique.
